subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should maintainers continue this original dirty draft, or make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 the canonical landing path for the Computer Use manifest contract after docs and security-boundary fixes?
rationale: The contract is additive but public plugin API, and its metadata is intended to inform app-owned Accessibility and Screen Recording discovery; automation cannot decide the permanent field shape or canonical branch while both PRs are open.

options.title: Use the rebased successor after fixes
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as the canonical branch, complete docs and security-boundary review there, and leave this original draft open only until maintainers explicitly retire or supersede it.

options.title: Rebase this original branch
options.body: Ask the author to resolve the dirty branch, refresh `docs/docs_map.md`, and keep this PR as the landing path for the contract.

options.title: Pause the contract
options.body: Keep both draft branches parked until the macOS host binding design is settled enough to publish a plugin manifest API.

recommendation.title: Use the rebased successor after fixes
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as the canonical branch, complete docs and security-boundary review there, and leave this original draft open only until maintainers explicitly retire or supersede it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on this manifest/docs surface and opened the rebased successor PR that now carries the same contract.
